cards.title: A check that spans a laptop sleep is killed, and its duration is a lie
A git checkout in the repo silently reverts a concurrent board write
The audit budget is a rendering budget, not a cancellation
Two more hook tests ride the audit budget the same way SW-054 did
A check's timeout does not bound it — the kill leaves grandchildren holding the pipe
Nothing makes a session commit notes.jsonl
The session-start audit test fails under load, because the budget is the assertion
The tracker dirties its own tree, so every piece of evidence is born unanchored
tracker-store.mjs is a binary file to git
Ignore .claude/worktrees — a stray add would commit a whole worktree
A check inherits SHIPWARD_TRACKER — a suite could reach the live board
Publish — licence, README, and strip the scaffolding before the repo goes public
A CLI surface so the protocol is not Claude-Code-shaped only
Render through pure functions so the desk is testable without a DOM
The fleet answers questions — one standup across every board
Trust panel — surface the reported tier the desk never shows
Evidence expires — recall and the desk mark notes git has moved past
Verification gating — done() runs the card's check and records what it proved
standup’s "shipped in the last 7 days" list is uncapped
recall caps entry count but not bytes
start() hands back the whole note, unclipped
Archive shipped cards’ notes out of the hot tracker
A way back — the desk links to the fleet that opened it
The fleet starts itself — a launchd agent, installed by script
Onboard from the fleet — a button, not a command
Fleet view — one page over every onboarded board
replace() warns when a write drops most of the board
setup.mjs — onboard any repo in one command
Pushed does not mean production — say what git can prove
Product-fit pass — elapsed time, resolve links, log filters, tabular figures
A11y pass — keyboard status moves, contrast, motion, announcements
Feed entries roll off the cap into an archive, not the void
Structured note entries — kinds and resolves become facts, not guesses
done() nudges when a note teaches the next session nothing
The desk overflows horizontally below ~444px
The feed is the product — a log, not one line
Git is authoritative — reconcile instead of report
SessionStart reports board-vs-git drift
sync reads git itself — derive status instead of asserting it
MCP cancellation is accepted and ignored
MCP server: the Blind Hunter's 13 findings
Tracker lock: the layer under the SW-010 fix
Status line and hooks: terminal injection, truncation, and a hang
Harden memory-lib against the edge-case review
Ambient status line — know without looking
Hooks — make the Shipward protocol continuous, not aspirational
Close the memory loop — standup carries it, recall retrieves it
Memory view — render what Claude knows, not just what is in flight
Update the SPEC to match what was built
Remove the Raw data view
A live lock is broken as stale — silent lost write
Build the Shipward desk core (server + board)
Distill the design handoff into a SPEC contract
Archive view — shipped cards table
Raw data view — JSON with copy button
MCP server so Claude Code reaches the tracker over MCP (stage B)
Cross-process safe tracker writes — shared store + lock
Prefer MCP in CLAUDE.md and make the header tag live
PUT /api/tracker is last-write-wins — decide if it should be
serve.test.mjs binds a fixed port and cannot run concurrently
